routing_warnings.description: The concept-completion update concerns progress on the overall thumbnail artifact and does not claim use of the required subject-image source.
Completion of five thumbnail concepts concerns the overall thumbnail deliverable and does not establish that their subject images came from the current video.
The decision not to use the submitted designs concerns the overall thumbnail artifact and does not specifically remove or change the subject-image-source requirement.
Completion of five thumbnail concepts concerns the overall thumbnail artifact and does not establish compliance with the AI editing policy.
